measurement: Actual semantic demand: count pure-recall marks for every authored card and activity subpart; do not infer solely from subtype or Bloom labels.

actions.subject_over_warning: Review and rebalance to retain headroom.
actions.subject_over_ceiling: Block publication until recall demand is rebalanced.

authority: 25% subject ceiling: syllabus. 24% subject warning: local operational policy. No per-topic cap.
denominator: All subject cards and all activity parts, weighted by marks; never per-topic card marks alone.
